text: For 26 years, Indu Kadambi has called Los Altos Hills home and worked to protect the qualities that make it exceptional, natural beauty, rural character, strong neighborhoods, and thoughtful local leadership.

She brings a proven record of service as a Los Altos Hills County Fire District Commissioner, educator, small business owner, published author, PTA leader, and longtime school volunteer. Through her leadership with Hills 2000 and Friends of Los Altos Hills, Indu Kadambi has helped residents stay informed, engaged, and heard in decisions that shape the town's future.

With a master's degree in clinical psychology, she leads with empathy, sound judgment, and collaboration. Her experience reflects a deep commitment to public safety, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and accountable government.

Guided by an Indigenous proverb, "We do not inherit the Earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children," Indu believes we have a responsibility to preserve Los Altos Hills for today's residents and future generations. She is committed to protecting, preserving, and enriching the community we all value, for the families who live here today and those who will call Los Altos Hills home in the years ahead.

text: Town of Los Altos Hills Planning Commissioner

Six years on the Planning Commission has given me direct experience with housing law, land use, open space, pathways, tree and view protection, multifamily development, and the decisions that shape and protect the Town's semi-rural character. California's housing laws are creating mandates for increased density in town, and we can meet our housing obligations with adequate additional development that doesn't surrender what makes Los Altos Hills special, if we respond strategically.

Beyond housing, fiscally responsible, effective Town government must remain the Town's primary focus, including providing core services: public safety, emergency preparedness, infrastructure, and resident services. As a business owner and engineer, I have spent my career evaluating complex tradeoffs, building consensus, planning, budgeting, and being accountable─skills that translate directly to effective Town leadership.

My wife and I have lived in Los Altos Hills for 28 years, raised our children here, and now look forward to sharing with our grandchildren the same cherished open spaces, pathways, equestrian traditions, and semi-rural character that we moved here to find.
Residents deserve a Councilmember with the experience to protect what matters most. Vote for Los Altos Hills─Vote for Jim Waschura. Learn more at www.jimwaschura.com

text: I have called Los Altos Hills home for 22 years, where my husband and I have raised our two children. Serving as Chair of the Los Altos Hills Parks, Recreation, and Community Events Committee has deepened my appreciation for the values that make our town a special place to live. I treasure the unique character of Los Altos Hills, its open space, scenic pathways, and strong volunteers. As a physician specializing in neurohospital medicine, I have built my career on listening carefully, evaluating information thoughtfully, and making decisions with integrity and compassion.

I am running for Town Council to help preserve the unique character of Los Altos Hills while planning responsibly for its future. I am committed to maintaining our rural environment, protecting our beautiful pathway network, and prioritizing safety. I also believe in fostering opportunities for residents to connect through activities that promote health, wellness, and community.

I will be a thoughtful, accessible, and dedicated voice for our residents. I believe effective leadership begins with listening, and I will work hard to ensure every perspective is heard. By doing my homework, asking thoughtful questions, and making informed decisions, I will always put the long-term interests of our community first. I would be honored to earn your support and the opportunity to serve Los Altos Hills.
